title: The kbmon mod parses a needs-you row cut at the pane width as a whole line when --status all answers without a needs-you line, so a cut suffix reads as an entry
goal: the kbmon mod tells nothing for a needs-you row that kbmon cut with an ellipsis when --status all gave no whole line
notes: Found by the review of SP-rin4kkoj (2026-10-24, S3), not triggered by the reviewer; the planted repro reaches it with a --status all that answers without a needs-you line. register.tsx notifyNeeds falls back to the pane row, which may end in an ellipsis; entriesOf then reads a cut part such as `not r…` as an entry of a complete line. Fix: skip the reading (leave the row unread, as a failed --status all does) when the row is cut and the whole line is missing.
